personality_one_liner: A cinematic, expensive, and photo-first experience where the user's memories are treated like high-end art.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like breathing room. Cards and images are the hero. Never cram content. Use padding effectively to make elements feel premium.

do's: Sticky CTA bar at the bottom for 'Take Selfie' or main actions.
Modals, tooltips, and bottom sheet handles.
Ensure ≥75% tint opacity underneath glass in dark mode to preserve readability.
dont's: Applying glass to every list item.
Form fields or body text regions.
Failing to layer a solid/tint base under the blur for contrast.

screens.name: Auth (Login / OTP)
screens.purpose: Secure gateway for both clients and studio admins.
screens.layout: Cinematic split or full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse). Large serif greeting. Clean, single-column input fields with no floating labels.

screens.name: Client Events List
screens.purpose: Shows galleries shared with the client.

states.loading: Skeleton UI of large quilted image cards.
states.empty: Icon + 'No events found. Waiting for studio invite.' + Refresh CTA.

screens.layout: Large, edge-to-edge or quilted cards. Each event acts as a hero image with a 3-stop vertical dark scrim (0% to 70% surface) and elegant serif titles placed in the bottom 30%.

screens.name: Client Event Gallery & My Photos
screens.purpose: Displays ~1000 event photos with a sticky toggle between 'All Photos' and 'My Photos'.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'Scan your face to find your photos'.

screens.layout: Masonry grid for photos to accommodate varied aspect ratios. Sticky segmented control at the top (frosted glass). A sticky primary CTA ('Find My Photos' / 'Scan Face') hovering at the bottom center, wrapped in glass. Clicking a photo opens a full-screen pinch-to-zoom modal.

screens.name: Selfie Capture & Biometric Consent
screens.purpose: The core onboarding flow to locate the client in the gallery using AWS Rekognition.

states.loading: Analysis in progress with a subtle scanning animation.
states.error: Quality check failure (e.g., 'Too dark', 'Please retake'). High contrast actionable text.

screens.layout: Step 1: Minimalist consent screen with clear typography. Step 2: Full-screen camera view. Overlay must have >50% opacity mask around the face silhouette. Real-time feedback text must be high contrast. Use auto-capture when conditions (lighting, alignment) are met. Do not rely solely on colors for status.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Event management, photo uploading, indexing status, and access control.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for metric cards and event list.

screens.layout: Utility-first but still premium. Stacked modules. A clean status pill (brandTertiary bg) for indexing status. List of events with options to manage client access, set similarity threshold (slider/input), and revoke biometric data.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Glass / Luxe (DARK) personality. Do not use any blues, indigos, purples, or generic Material defaults.
Use a masonry layout for the photo gallery screens to support varying photo dimensions without awkward cropping.

For the Selfie Capture screen, implement a strict sequence: Consent -> Camera View -> Actionable UI feedback (not just colors) -> Auto Capture. The camera overlay mask must be at least 50% opacity outside the silhouette.
Any text overlaid on an image (e.g., Event covers) MUST use a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >= 70% surfaceInverse or surface) to guarantee WCAG AA readability.
Keep typography weights at 400 (Geist) and 500 (Cormorant Garamond) maximum. Rely on size for hierarchy, never heavy weights.
Ensure 'My Photos' vs 'All Photos' toggle is sticky at the top using expo-blur frosted glass.
Include the defined haptics for premium, tactile feedback.
